Speaker A: देखा भैया, कितना इजी है। बस मैं रोज़ 10 से 15 मिनट प्रैक्टिस करता हूँ। बस 10 दिन हुए हैं और मेरी इंग्लिश देखो काफी फ्लूएंट हो चुकी है। [See brother, how easy it is. on_screen_text: What is the price of tomatoes today? SpeakX. AI Teacher. Do you have fresh coriander today? 7-day trial for ₹2.
summary: A young man demonstrates how he uses the SpeakX AI tutor to practice English in real-life situations, like buying vegetables. The vendor is impressed by the app's utility and its low cost of just ₹2 for a 7-day trial.
